michellenatasya.name: Micel
michellenatasya.message: I know we ended up being friend in unexpected circumstances, but I am glad I have you in my hard days. Thank you for being in my life, and I wish we will continue become friends, til the end <3

alficopermana.name: Fico
alficopermana.message: Thank you fico, for being in my life. I know we didn't end in the best circumstances, but I am still grateful for all the things you gave me. Makasih yaa udah inget ultahku!  I hope you the best for your life.

dewianggraeni.name: Dewi
dewianggraeni.message: Thank you for being the best sister ever! I am so glad I can witness many part of your life, and vice versa, love you <3

raynaldo.name: Ray
raynaldo.message: Thank you for being my first friends in NielsenIQ🤍. I hope you are always showered with Happiness, Ray!

LaelaBiella.name: Bella
LaelaBiella.message: Thank you for always being my +1 in every occasion, bella. I am glad to know a beautiful soul like yours. I hope we stay friends for long!

AmandaFathia.name: Manda
AmandaFathia.message: If there's one thing that I happy to get from my time being HR, it is you, Manda. Bad things give good things also, I am glad it is you. I love you.

VannessWu.name: Vanness
VannessWu.message: If anything, you see me through my darkest, and still stayed. I am so blessed to have a friend like you, ness. I hope we stay friend for long!

alyciaswara.name: Ais
alyciaswara.message: Thank you ais for being the most unhinged friend in the group. Thank you for being in my life, and I hope we will catch a lunch soon, hun!

deannabeatrice.name: Dea
deannabeatrice.message: Dea, thank you so much for all the helps you give when I need! I really enjoyed having political philosopical talk with you. Catch up with you soon!

MarianaSalma.name: Salma
MarianaSalma.message: Salma, thank you for having the sweetest heart. I am glad I become your friend, you are one unique woman that I adore very much <3 I hope we stay friends forever!

rahmansatya.name: Satya
rahmansatya.message: Satya, thanks for being the funniest gentleman in the group! Aku seneng banget kita ketemu sebagai limalima and continue being good friend, goodluck on binabola, pak CEO!

stephani.name: Stephani
stephani.message: Step, GILA lu keren banget. If anything I learn from you, is to learn to believe in the process. I saw you from SAP, and I am so proud of how far you've become. Thank you for being my friend <3

ingwening.name: Wening
ingwening.message: Wening, kita udah lama ga catch up! But thanks for wishing me happy birthday! I wish I could hear more from you, but wherever you are in life, I hope you win and I really root for you. Catch up with you soon!

adrian.name: Adrian
adrian.message: Adrian, thanks for wishing me happy birthday! I hope you do well in Japan! I think it's for work? I look forward to catch up with you and hear your story and journey! Good luck bro!

hansennathaniel.name: Hansenita
hansennathaniel.message: HANSEN I MISS YOU! I think I said that a lot to other! Well, I hope you do well in work, and in life in general. You are a very precious person which existence I cherish and never a dull moment with u!

ilmagita.name: IlmaGithub
ilmagita.message: Ilma thanks yah for wishing me happy birthday! Keep being the cool girl I know (lu jg cool girl), and I adore how unhinged you are sometimes. Semangat di orenn!

dziyalorika.name: Dziya Handsome Game Master
dziyalorika.message: Dziya, thank you for being my friend ya (walau lu punya banyak teman), but I really cherish all moment we had, most of them involving singing. Thank you for being in my life, you added one unique color!

daviddd.name: David Dewanto
daviddd.message: I can't thank you enough for everything you did for me. All the free rides, the deep talks, the treats, I owe you a lot, and I wouldn't be me if it weren't for you. Thank you for being in my life.
